note: Researched themes for NEXT BOOM. read.py posts up to 3 not used in the last 14 days; themes older than 21 days are treated as stale. Refill via web research.

themes.thesis: Betting on outcomes is becoming a mass-market financial product.
themes.window_basis: NFL season + 2026 US midterms (Nov 3) drive record volume
why_now: Q3 volume **$189B**, up **81%** q/q and **~22x** a year ago
Kalshi record day **$3.9B** (Oct 4); weekly volume doubled in 6 weeks
Robinhood and DraftKings launched venues this summer
themes.crypto_note: Polymarket settles on Polygon; UMA is its oracle
themes.invalidation: A CFTC or state crackdown on sports contracts.

themes.thesis: Quantum is shifting from lab demos to government-tested machines.
themes.window_basis: DARPA Stage C runs through 2029; fault tolerance targeted 2028–29
why_now: DARPA moved IonQ, IBM, Atom, Diraq to final stage (**up to $300M** each)
IonQ hit a record **1 kHz** quantum interconnect (Oct 9)
Xanadu chips enter GlobalFoundries production (**+17%** on news)
themes.crypto_note: No clean token. Post-quantum risk is a long-term BTC talking point
themes.invalidation: Stage C milestones slip or funding is cut.

themes.thesis: Reactor demand is outrunning fuel supply while miners still lag.
themes.window_basis: Utility contracting season after the September symposium
why_now: Google (**890 MW**) and Amazon sign 20-year nuclear deals
Kazatomprom plant delays limit supply; miners still **-7% to -45%** YTD
themes.invalidation: Spot falls back under $80/lb or utilities stall contracts.

themes.thesis: SpaceX's listing gives the whole space sector a price anchor.
themes.window_basis: Starship reached orbit; Q3 results and lockups in November
why_now: SpaceX **+48%** from its August low, back above **$160**
Starship reached orbit for the first time (late September)
Peers sold off on the IPO and haven't caught up
themes.invalidation: November lockup selling breaks SpaceX below $135.

themes.thesis: US rules turn stablecoins into licensed payment rails.
why_now: Stablecoin supply **$313B**, up two months in a row
CEX stablecoin volume back above **$1T** a month
Circle's Arc mainnet live; Treasury and Fed rules proposed
themes.invalidation: Final rules shut out yield-bearing or offshore stablecoins.

themes.thesis: Bittensor subnets are starting to earn and trade with each other.
why_now: Gamma tokens let subnets buy compute from each other
Upgrades v475 to v477 open up subnet design
themes.invalidation: Gamma slips or subnet revenue stalls.
